name: LaunchWord
label: Launch Word
description: Launches a new Word instance or opens a Word document.

fields.name: LaunchMode
fields.label: Launch Mode
fields.description: Select how to launch Word: 'Blank Document' or 'Open Existing Document'.

selectOptions.label: Blank Document
selectOptions.description: Launches Excel with a blank document.

selectOptions.label: Open Existing Document
selectOptions.description: Launches Excel and opens the specified document.

fields.name: DocumentPath
fields.label: Document Path
fields.description: The file path of the document to open. Required if 'Launch Mode' is 'Open Existing Document'.

fields.name: MakeInstanceVisible
fields.label: Make Instance Visible
fields.description: Specifies whether the Word application window should be visible.

fields.name: WordInstance
fields.label: Word Instance
fields.description: The specific Word instance for use with later Word actions. This allows the user to specify which of possibly several Word documents to access.
